Thanks for sending the MAP and the eval artifacts. Quick read-through notes and a proposed approval script below. I'm pulling Legal and Finance into the minimal decision path so we can keep the signer rotation tight.

High-level ask: confirm go/no-go decision window and a DocuSign send no later than 2026-10-20 to preserve the 11/02 start slot. If procurement needs more time on PO -- give us the latest PO receipt date you can accept.

Proposed Exit-lane Approval Script (compact):
1) Legal review complete (Redwood legal) — final redlines accepted or converted to SOW appendix (owner: Karthik).
2) Procurement confirms PO amount and tax/invoicing (owner: Lumen procurement / Priya).
3) Exec commercial signoff (Kim) — confirms price/commitment and go/no-go.
4) DocuSign send -> signatures -> Redwood receives fully executed SOW.
5) Ops checklist: model pin, capacity reservation, test plan run (owner: Jordan).

Please confirm if Priya needs a contract clean copy or if the draft SOW is ok for PO processing. Also flag whether Lumen needs an SLA attachment or the standard Redwood SLA will suffice.

If legal can turn around redlines by 2026-09-09 and procurement can confirm PO constraints this week, I'll route the final SOW for exec signoff by 2026-09-10.

Kim
